sources.title: Toward Embodied AGI: A Review of Embodied AI and the Road Ahead - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) is often envisioned as inherently embodied. With recent advances in robotics and foundational AI models, we stand at the threshold of a new era—one marked by increasingly generalized embodied AI systems.
